item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.
